narrative.overview:
The home page introduces Anish to people looking him up: photo, name, bio, three plain-language focus areas, a few selected talks and posts, and contact. Its first screen is a deep spruce band that runs full width behind the header and the hero; a short saffron bar under the name is the one bright mark. Below the band the page is a pale spruce-tinted ground with dark spruce ink, and saffron returns only where something can be acted on: link underlines, action links, focus rings, text selection.

The full record lives on `/work/` ("Features I've shipped"). There, features advance across a fixed grid of Kubernetes releases, read the way release notes and enhancement tracking read: hairline rules, numerals set large and light. Three stage hues say what stage a feature reached, and every stage is also drawn in a distinct line weight, so the ledger still reads in greyscale. The one interaction lights a feature's posts and talks in the record and unlights the rest.
keyCharacteristics: Two tones carry the identity: spruce (the band) and saffron (action and focus). Stage hues appear only on stages.
Two self-hosted variable faces: Jost (geometric, Futura lineage) names things; DM Sans carries text. Tabular figures for every date and version.
Hairline rules for rows; no cards, no shadows, no radii. The band is the only filled surface.
A release axis of large light numerals over a grid of ghost cells.
Colour-only motion, removed under reduced motion.

rules.name: The Two Tones Rule
rules.body: Spruce owns the top of the home page; saffron marks the name, action and focus. No other brand hue, no tints beyond the 70% underline mix, no gradients.

rules.name: The Stage Hue Rule
rules.body: Alpha rust, beta olive and GA teal appear only where a stage is named or drawn. They never mark links, hover or decoration.

rules.name: The Double Code Rule
rules.body: Every stage is coded twice, by hue and by line weight: alpha is a 2px dashed line, beta a 3px solid line, GA a 0.5rem solid block, GA target a 0.5rem box outlined with a 1.5px dashed GA border. The stage name is always written as text beside the line.

rules.name: The Unlit Rule
rules.body: Quieting is done by reassigning the three stage properties and text colour to ink 3, never by opacity, blur or filter. Unlit content still passes AA.

rules.name: The Two Faces Rule
rules.body: Jost names things, DM Sans says things. No third face.

rules.name: The Tabular Rule
rules.body: Every date, version and release number is set with tabular figures, so columns of numerals align without a monospace face.

rules.name: The Light Numeral Rule
rules.body: Numerals that index the record (release axis, years) are set large at Jost 300; words that name things are set at 500 to 650. Weight separates index from content.

rules.name: The Every Cell Exists Rule
rules.body: Each release column in each feature row is drawn as a ghost cell (a 1px rule tick and a 1px rule baseline), whether or not a stage occurred. Stages are laid over the cells; nothing is drawn to fill an empty release.

rules.name: The Flat Paper Rule
rules.body: No `box-shadow`, no elevation, no raised panels. If something needs separating, use a rule or space.

rules.name: The Square Corner Rule
rules.body: Nothing is rounded. A corner radius would turn a row into a card.

rules.name: The Colour-Only Motion Rule
rules.body: The only motion is a 160ms colour change on the cross-highlight. No transforms, no entrance animation, no scroll effects, and none at all under reduced motion.

dos: Do read every colour through the custom properties so both themes and the unlit state work without extra rules.
Do keep saffron off text on the light ground; use `accent` for saffron-coloured text.
Do pair every stage hue with its line weight and written name: alpha 2px dashed, beta 3px solid, GA 0.5rem block, GA target 0.5rem dashed box.
Do draw every release cell for every feature, lit or not.
Do set dates, versions and release numbers in tabular figures; set index numerals in Jost 300 and names at 500 to 650.
Do keep interactive text targets at 44px where they stand alone (nav, footer, actions, folded stage links).
Do quiet by switching to ink 3, and keep that state AA.
donts: Don't add a brand hue beyond spruce and saffron, or use a stage hue for links, hover or decoration.
Don't use cards, panels, shadows or rounded corners; the band is the only filled surface.
Don't use gradients of any kind.
Don't use icon glyphs (icon fonts, SVG pictograms, emoji, arrows as icons); the drawn line samples, the saffron bar and the toggle's drawn square are the only marks.
Don't use terminal costume: no monospace, prompt characters, typewriter effects, blinking cursors or window chrome.
Don't animate position, size or opacity; motion is colour only, and none under reduced motion.
Don't quiet content with opacity or blur.
